thing with Bill Evans or Cecil Taylor.

Yeah, but when I looked and saw just one solo I figured it had to be 78. But anyway, we have in this collection a 78 that Cliff made in 1926 and one of the selections is "Maple Leaf Rag" of course, and the other one is "The Entertainer."
